brief:
Trump claimed that intense hatred of Israel in America caused his defeat in the 2020 presidential election, Ma'an Wire reported. The former president linked anti-Israel sentiment among American voters to his electoral loss without providing evidence for the connection.

The statement reflects Trump's framing of his loss as driven by external hostility rather than other political factors. He has previously attributed his 2020 defeat to various causes while maintaining that the election was compromised.
title: Trump blames antisemitism for 2020 election loss
